research_summary: DA1 already has first-page visibility but very low CTR. The improved page leads with the exact Dartford query, adds Ofcom-derived local coverage, qualifies street-level availability, retains deal sorting, adds a household speed decision tool and expands evidence-led local guidance.
depth_rationale: The strongest local competitors combine roughly 900 to 1,200 words with postcode interaction and detailed deal attributes, while a national authority page is substantially deeper. A 1,200-word minimum is appropriate because the page must answer local coverage, provider, price, speed, switching and moving-home intent without padding.
